title: Items, quantities and clinical records for Urology and Continence Supply Program refills
content:
A refill on the Urology and Continence Supply Program may carry only items that the covered-items list shows for the program's product line. An intermittent catheter program receives only the tip written on the program. The test reads the program's product line and catheter tip.

## Units of each item

The units of each item are the tier's monthly allowance for that item times the supply days divided by 30, or the written order's quantity when that is lower. *This clause is no longer in force for a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program, whose units are set by the current basis for such a refill. For every other refill it remains in force.* An item whose allowance is 0 is not covered on the tier.

*Hypothetical, for a refill this clause governs:* an allowance of 35 units per 30 days and 90 supply days give 35 times 90 divided by 30, which is 105 units. If the written order's quantity is lower, the order's quantity is used.

## Absorbent products

Absorbent products are covered only on tiers whose covered-items schedule shows absorbent products as covered. On those tiers, briefs and liners of all sizes together may not exceed the tier's combined absorbent figure per 30 days of supply. On other tiers a customer may buy them at the cash price under the liability notice rule. On the Original Medicare tier they are never billed to Medicare, because Medicare does not cover them.

## Items that ship only with a practitioner record on file

| Item or quantity | Tiers concerned | Record that must be on file |
|---|---|---|
| Coude-tip catheter (A4352) | where a coude-tip record is required | a medical record whose purpose is coude-tip justification |
| Closed-system catheter (A4353) | where a closed-system record is required | a medical record whose purpose is closed-system qualification |
| Absorbent products | Continence Medicaid Program | a medical record whose purpose is incontinence assessment |
| A quantity above the allowance | every tier with above-allowance coverage | a medical record whose purpose is over-limit justification, dated no more than the tier's above-allowance record age in calendar months before the ship date |

Without the over-limit record, the extra quantity ships only under the liability notice rule.

## Self-pay and replacements

On the Continence Self-Pay Program every item is sold at the cash price, up to the written order's quantity. A replacement never exceeds the units of the shipment it replaces.
